failed_outcomes.name: github_project_inventory
failed_outcomes.observed: The active GitHub token lacks read:project scope. Governance defines GitHub Issues and their native relationships as the authoritative tracker; Project aggregation is optional, so no Project read or mutation was required or attempted after the scope failure.

observations.expected: One root issue owns the approved EOS, Regression, and Equilibrium hard cutover.
observations.observed: Issue 10 owns eleven native sub-issues covering CAP-01 through CAP-11.

observations.name: dependency_graph
observations.expected: Executable leaves use native blocked-by relationships in the approved dependency order.

observations.expected: No open issue preserves a conflicting split-wheel, SDK, source-specific runtime, or polyrepo transfer plan.

observations.expected: Every issue mutation is visible and queryable after publication.

preconditions: The user explicitly authorized issue creation and reconciliation.
The canonical hard-cutover and three owner plans were complete and approved for issue publication.
All nine pre-existing issues, their bodies, comments, labels, states, and native relationships were audited before mutation.
The authenticated repository resolved exactly to private tannerpolley/ePC-SAFT.
expected_postconditions: Issue 10 remains the sole root for the general scientific capability cutover.
CAP-01 through CAP-11 retain native parent and blocker relationships.
The open frontier begins with issue 11 unless a later explicit tracker decision changes dependencies.
Deferred MEA issue 6 remains blocked until issue 20 completes.
Closed migration/source-specific issues do not regain authority by retaining historical comments.
record.retry: No retry is pending. Any correction must inspect the exact current issue node and apply a bounded edit without recreating duplicate issues.
stop_conditions: A second root is created for the same capability cutover.
A leaf loses its native parent or approved blocked-by relationship.
A closed split-wheel, SDK, source-specific runtime, or polyrepo migration issue is reopened without a new current-state decision.
An issue body contradicts Governance revision 12 or the canonical owner plans.
record.reversibility: Titles, bodies, labels, relationships, and open/closed state can be edited through a separately authorized tracker operation. Closed issues can be reopened if a new current-state decision justifies them.
irreversible_effects: Created issue numbers and external audit history cannot be erased through ordinary issue editing.
Closing and revision comments remain part of GitHub issue history.
